label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.104…… supports Whatever causes the being of every other…
note: ST I q.104 a.1 co. (English translation) distinguishes a cause of an effect's becoming from a cause of its being, and says the being of every creature depends on God so that it would fall into nothingness without the divine operation. The premise states that whatever causes the being of every other being is the total cause of each such thing's being, not only of its coming to be in a presupposed subject. The article says God causes being and not merely becoming; that this causing is total, covering the whole being including any subject, is the analyst's step (creation from nothing, ST I q.45, is not pinned).
